answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 4 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in whisper, checked in lagoon, and ledge makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2341 identities would post 2626 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
